title: ScholiaLang MCP 0.7.3 manual acceptance smoke (codex)
authority: Report-only execution. No source edits, merge, deploy, PyPI publication, or Cloud propagation.
problem: Exercise the integrated 0.7.3 grammar/spec and MCP Events, Tasks, and Heartbeat features in one reproducible no-op run.
outcome: Durable receipt with exact SHA, grammar/spec checks, real stdio wire captures, and no tracked product changes.
hard_constraints: Do not modify tracked source or merge.
No PyPI, production, or Cloud claim.

stories.title: Grammar/spec verification
stories.description: Run the existing 0.7.3 artifact, grammar, and spec-fingerprint checks from the pinned integration tip; capture commands and results.

stories.title: Real MCP stdio features
stories.description: Run tests/integration/test_real_adapters.py and targeted protocol regressions to exercise authorized Events, Tasks, Heartbeat, default-off, malformed routing, revocation, and reconnect behavior over subprocess stdio; preserve wire captures.

stories.title: Acceptance receipt
stories.description: Write a report-only receipt with exact tip, commands, exit codes, captures, changed-file check, caveats, and verdict.

verification: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_core073_artifact_contract.py tests/test_spec_fingerprint_fixtures.py -q`, `python -m pytest tests/integration/test_real_adapters.py -q`, and the repository's targeted MCP protocol regressions; inspect captures and git diff.
rollback: Discard only report artifacts; preserve integration branch and backups.
